caption: larry's college years - the reboot that traded al lowe's prose for minigames and never apologized.
about: Leisure suit larry: magna cum laude (2004) reboots the series with larry lovage, nephew of the original: a college campus of dating minigames, quips and escalating double entendres. The sex content stays at the r-rated comedy line - the wall here is adult humor and topless cutscenes, not explicit imagery - and the minigame marathon structure remains the era's most honest simulation of collegiate flirting.
The windows build is delisted with the whole vivendi-era catalog, carried by archive routes.
